CRL.M.C. 6240/2024 & CRL. MA 23844/2024 (direction)
1. By way of present petition, the petitioner seeks quashing of the FIR No.0138/2024 registered under Sections 406/420/120B IPC at PS Connaught Place, New Delhi.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the present FIR has been lodged with the allegation that the complainant was induced by the petitioner to pay approximately Rs.2.5 lacs towards the purchase of a flat which was not delivered to him.
He further contends that the petitioner is only a Law Officer engaged with the accused company.
He, on instructions, submits that the amount so invested by the complainant was refunded back to him pursuant to a notice for cancellation of allotment given by the accused company.
It is submitted that the transaction is purely commercial in nature and that the registration of the instant FIR is only an arm-twisting This is a digitally signed order.
